data: Which of the following represents the model that performs best in 'Antonym Negation'?

The question asks which model performs best in 'Antonym Negation'. From the caption, we know that for each task, the best-performing language model (LM) is shown alongside the NO LANG. control and baseline model. In Figure 4(A), which corresponds to 'Antonym Negation', there are three lines representing different models: ROBERTA-L, ROBERTA-L No-Lang, and Baseline. The line representing the best-performing model will be the highest on the graph.

Looking at the graph, the red line (ROBERTA-L) appears to be the highest among the three lines throughout the training process. Therefore, the model that performs best in 'Antonym Negation' is ROBERTA-L.
